bio.text: Ben Ray Luján has represented New Mexico in the U.S. Senate since January 2021.
Before that he served as U.S. Representative for New Mexico's 3rd Congressional District, having first been elected to Congress in 2008, and was House Assistant Speaker in the 116th Congress.
He grew up in Nambé, a farming community north of Santa Fe.
He earned a bachelor's degree in business administration from New Mexico Highlands University.
